structured.answer: Harel has loads of products (pension, השתלמות, גמל להשקעה, קרן חדשה, חיסכון לכל ילד, קרנות סל); I only saw the קופת גמל להשקעה table, where every track costs about 0.55% and the only ones with returns are like מניות 24.04%/3y and S&P 500 13.7%/3y. Most rows show no return at all, and I still don't know which product my money is actually in.
